Job Description
A leading investment-focused organization is seeking a  Quantitative Analytics Engineer  to join a growing analytics and technology team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong quantitative and analytical thinking with practical software engineering skills, particularly in Python and SQL. 
You will work at the intersection of data, analytics, and application development, helping to build and enhance a cloud-based analytics platform that supports investment decision-making. The role includes designing data-driven workflows, developing internal applications, building data pipelines, and partnering closely with business stakeholders to transform complex requirements into scalable solutions. 
This position is well suited for a quantitative analyst who enjoys writing production-quality code, working with large datasets, and delivering tools that make sophisticated analysis accessible to end users.
Required Skills & Experience    3+ years of professional experience in quantitative analysis, analytics engineering, software development, or a related field  Strong Python experience developing production-quality applications, analytics solutions, or data platforms  3+ years of SQL experience, including complex queries and optimization against large datasets  Experience working with data modeling, data management, and data warehouse concepts  Experience building data-intensive applications or analytical platforms  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative reasoning abilities  Experience developing modern applications using TypeScript and/or React  Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure or comparable environments  Experience utilizing Git, CI/CD pipelines, and software development best practices  Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills
  Desired Skills & Experience    Experience with investment, financial, or quantitative analytics platforms  Familiarity with messaging technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Grid, or similar tools  Experience building APIs and backend services  Exposure to feature flagging, application observability, and monitoring practices  Experience supporting cloud-native applications and distributed systems  Interest in financial markets, investments, and data-driven decision making
  What You Will Be Doing
 Daily Responsibilities     Design and develop analytical applications, tools, and workflows used across the investment platform  Build and maintain scalable Python-based services, APIs, and data processing solutions  Develop complex SQL solutions to support reporting, analytics, and business processes  Create and enhance data pipelines and system integrations  Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions  Contribute to logical and physical data model design  Support platform reliability through testing, CI/CD improvements, monitoring, and observability enhancements  Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives  Troubleshoot production issues and drive continuous platform improvements  Help shape the future architecture and capabilities of a cloud-based analytics ecosystem
  The Offer    Base salary: $160,000 - $165,000  Eligible for discretionary annual bonus  Hybrid work environment  Opportunity to work on high-impact quantitative analytics initiatives  Collaborative, engineering-driven culture with strong opportunities for growth
